The plate is square, roughly 24 cm across. The pile of soft white crumbles covers about 40% of the plate's width and is roughly 2-3 cm high. Following the guidance for a large pile of soft white curds, I identified it as scrambled egg whites. The pile is about 12 cm by 11 cm, which gives a volume of around 150-200 cm³ allowing for air gaps. At a loose density of about 0.6-0.7 g/cm³, that comes to roughly 110 g.
